items.title: ArmSoM Sige6 Allwinner A733 SBC features up to 128GB soldered-on eMMC flash, 16GB LPDDR5
items.summary: ArmSoM Sige6 is yet another SBC powered by the Allwinner A733 octa-core SoC, offered in a credit card form factor with up to 128GB soldered-on eMMC flash and up to 16GB LPDDR5. The single board computer features a microSD card slot and an M.2 M-key PCIe 3.0 x2 slot for storage, Gigabit Ethernet (with optional PoE), WiFi 6, and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, HDMI 2.0 and MIPI DSI display interfaces, a MIPI CSI camera interface, USB 3.0/2.0 ports, a 3.5mm audio jack, a 40-pin GPIO header, and more. items.title_zh: ArmSoM Sige6单板计算机发布：搭载全志A733，最高板载128GB eMMC
items.summary_zh: ArmSoM推出Sige6单板计算机，搭载全志A733八核SoC（双核Cortex-A76＋六核Cortex-A55＋单核RISC-V E902实时核），板载最高128GB eMMC和16GB LPDDR5。板卡配备M.2 PCIe 3.0 x2插槽、千兆以太网（可选PoE）、WiFi 6、蓝牙5.4、HDMI 2.0、MIPI DSI/CSI、40针GPIO等接口，集成3 TOPS NPU。

items.title: Orange Pi Zero 4 – Compact Allwinner A733 SBC offers HDMI, USB-C DP, GbE, WiFI 6, PCIe FFC connector for $26.5 and up

items.title: JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity
items.summary: JetKVM Mini is a smaller, lower-cost version of the popular JetKVM KVM over IP solution. The new model features a small information display, offers Ethernet or WiFi connectivity, and supports 1080p video capture. The main under-the-hood change is that they ditched Linux on a Rockchip RV1106G3 SoC and now rely on an ESP32-P4X (ESP32-P4 version 3.x and greater) to handle video capture, H.264 encoding, USB, and other features. The largest cost saving is removing the RAM and eMMC flash required by Linux. JetKVM Mini specifications: SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-P4X CPU Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V HP (High-performance) CPU @ up to 400 MHz with AI instruction extension and single-precision FPU Single-RISC-V LP (Low-power) MCU core @ up to 40 MHz Memory 768 KB HP L2MEM (for dual-core CPU), 32 KB LP SRAM, 8 KB TCM (for LP MCU core) 32 MB PSRAM Storage – 128 KB HP ROM, 16 KB LP ROM [...] The post JetKVM Mini – A low-cost, ESP32-P4X-based KVM with Ethernet or WiFi connectivity appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: JetKVM Mini：基于ESP32-P4X的低成本KVM over IP方案
items.summary_zh: JetKVM Mini是JetKVM的小型低成本版本，搭载ESP32-P4X双核RISC-V SoC，支持1080p视频采集与H.264编码，提供以太网或WiFi连接，并配备小型信息显示屏。相比前代基于Linux的方案，去除了RAM和eMMC闪存以降低成本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方案展示了ESP32-P4X在KVM场景下替代Linux SoC的潜力，大幅简化硬件成本，适合远程管理应用。

items.title: ESP32-C5 Pico board follows Raspberry Pi Pico form factor, ships with on-board or external antenna
items.summary: Waveshare ESP32-C5 Pico board brings the ESP32-C5 dual-band WiFi 6, Bluetooth LE, and 802.15.4 (Zigbee/Thread) SoC to the Raspberry Pi Pico form factor. The board features an ESP32-C5-MINI-1 Series module with PCB or external antenna, two 20-pin GPIO headers, a USB-C port for power and programming, Reset and Boot buttons, and a few LEDs. It also supports Li-Ion battery charging and discharging. items.summary_zh: Waveshare ESP32-C5 Pico采用树莓派Pico外形设计，搭载ESP32-C5-MINI-1模块，支持双频WiFi 6、Bluetooth LE及802.15.4（Zigbee/Thread）。板载单核RISC-V处理器@240MHz，配备USB-C接口、双20-pin GPIO排针及Li-Ion电池充放电，可选PCB或外置天线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该板将ESP32-C5的WiFi 6与Thread/Zigbee能力引入Pico生态，丰富了物联网原型开发选项。

items.title: YuzukiNeko – A Linux-capable Allwinner F101 RISC-V SBC with Raspberry Pi Pico form factor
items.summary: YuzukiHD has made another open-source hardware Linux SBC. YuzukiNeko is a Raspberry Pi Pico-sized single board computer powered by a new Allwinner F101 RISC-V SoC. The Allwinner F101 processor features a single 1.008 GHz C907 RISC-V core, 8MB or 16 MB PSRAM, and support for various display interfaces such as MIPI DSI, 24-bit RGB, and LVDS. The YuzukiNeko board itself features the F101 SoC, an SPI NOR flash, a microSD card for storage, a USB-C port, and two 20-pin GPIO headers. items.title: Amlogic A311Y3 Cortex-A78/A55 Edge AI system-on-module delivers up to 8 TOPS
items.summary: Boardcon CM311Y3 system-on-module (SoM) is powered by an Amlogic A311Y3 octa-core Cortex-A78/A55 SoC with an 8 TOPS NPU and targets 4K video surveillance systems, AI edge computing devices, interactive terminals, enterprise thin clients, and autonomous robots. The module comes with up to 16GB LPDDR5 and up to 256 GB eMMC flash, exposes 210 pins through castellated edges, and a development board is also provided for evaluation and early software development. We don’t often see new SoMs or SBCs based on Amlogic SoCs these days, so let’s have a closer look. items.title: Zstd Improvement For Linux 7.4 To Avoid Redundant Initialization
items.summary: In addition to Usama Arif's recent Linux patches for addressing a major inefficiency within the Linux kernel's Zstd compression code, he also has a separate patch series destined for Linux 7.4 to further enhance the Zstd compression/decompression performance by avoiding redundant initialization...
items.title_zh: Linux 7.4将进一步优化Zstd压缩，避免冗余初始化
items.summary_zh: 除了Usama Arif最近提交的修复Linux内核Zstd压缩代码重大低效问题的补丁外，他还准备了另一组针对Linux 7.4的补丁系列，通过避免冗余初始化进一步提升Zstd压缩与解压性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这些优化可减少不必要的内存初始化开销，显著提升内核中Zstd压缩与解压的执行效率。

items.title: BFS File-System Being Removed For Linux 7.4
items.summary: The latest upstream file-system to be removed from the mainline Linux kernel is... BFS...
items.title_zh: BFS文件系统将在Linux 7.4中被移除
items.summary_zh: Linux 7.4将移除主线内核中的BFS文件系统。BFS此前作为上游文件系统长期保留在Linux内核中，由于缺乏持续维护，在本轮内核更新中被正式删除。
items.why_it_matters_zh: BFS作为内核中长期存在的文件系统被移除，体现了上游维护者持续清理无活跃维护代码、精简内核的策略方向。

items.title: GCC 13.5 Released With 265+ Bug Fixes
items.summary: For those continuing to rely on the GCC 13 compiler in production that debuted more than three years ago, GCC 13.5 released today with more than 265 bug fixes. GCC 13.5 also caps off the GCC 13 series as the last planned point release...
items.title_zh: GCC 13.5 发布，修复超过 265 个 Bug
items.summary_zh: GCC 13.5 编译器今日发布，包含超过 265 个 Bug 修复。作为 GCC 13 系列的收官版本，GCC 13.5 是该三年多前首发系列的最后一个计划更新，仍在生产环境中使用旧版本的用户值得关注。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是 GCC 13 系列的最后一个版本，为仍依赖此版本的生产环境用户提供重要的稳定性修复。

items.title: Intel BFF Driver Slated For Linux 7.4 Introduction
items.summary: Last month I covered Intel posting a new driver named "BFF" for the Linux kernel. This BFF driver is for a new hardware feature debuting with next-gen Diamond Rapids processors for better dealing with aging CPU silicon where some bits may become stuck over time...
items.title_zh: Intel BFF 驱动将随 Linux 7.4 引入
items.summary_zh: Intel 此前发布了名为 BFF 的新型 Linux 内核驱动，计划随 Linux 7.4 正式合并。该驱动面向下一代 Diamond Rapids 处理器，用于处理 CPU 硅片老化导致部分比特卡死的问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 新驱动针对下一代 Diamond Rapids 处理器，应对硅片老化引发的比特卡死问题，体现 Intel 在硬件可靠性管理上的新方向。

items.title: GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB-to-GPIB adapter gains Ethernet (PoE), but launches as closed-source hardware
items.summary: Last December, we wrote about XyphroLabs’s UsbGpib open-source hardware, affordable, and portable USB-to-GPIB adapter designed for legacy GPIB/IEEE-488 instruments and offering modern hardware and software. At the time, the UsbGpib V3 was also in the works with Ethernet (PoE) support, and the good news is that it’s now available, but named GPIBee. The less good news is that while V1 and V2 were both open-source hardware products (and still are), the GPIBee has been released as closed-source hardware for reasons we’ll explain below. GPIBee specifications: Microcontroller – Not disclosed. But not the Microchip ATMega32U4 8-bit AVR MCU found in V2 since its USB interface is limited to 12 Mbps Host interfaces USB 2.0 (480 Mbps) Type-C port with support for four modes Full USBTMC (USB Test and Measurement Class) VXI-11 over USB-Ethernet (CDC NCM) linux-gpib native interface Prologix-compatible (++ commands) via CDC UART (virtual COM port) 10/100Mbps Ethernet RJ45 port [...] The post GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB-to-GPIB adapter gains Ethernet (PoE), but launches as closed-source hardware appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
